strategy.name: Phase-2 fundamental RV mean-reversion (WTI & Brent, daily, 5y)
strategy.desc: Fair value from the Phase-2 fundamentals regression (walk-forward, out-of-sample); fade a >=1.5sigma residual dislocation; exit on reversion to fair (|z|<=0.5), a 3sigma stop, or a 20-day time stop. Traded universe pruned to the 5 structures with a persistent after-cost edge (the two Brent front calendars, which lose, are dropped). 1 unit/trade.
